newsitem.title: USA: U.S West Coast prods static amid low demand, NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: U.S West Coast prods static amid low demand, NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. West Coast bulk product prices were static late Thursday with lower NYMEX prices offset by weak demand in the region, traders said.
Business picked up early as traders found direction in the futures a day after its volatile rise and fall, traders said.
Crude oil for February delivery traded down 43 cents a barrel to $25.52 a barrel.
And the front-month gasoline contract was seen down about 0.16 cent a gallon at 68.69 cents.
Traders reported CARB grade gasoline for January delivery in Los Angeles eased 0.50 cents a gallon to 75/76 cents a gallon.
Conventional gasoline in L.A. was unchanged at 74/75 cents a gallon.
